Sol Holo bundles the face-landmarker model and the required WebAssembly files
inside the application. The copied JavaScript bundle is modified during the
build so its external usage-metrics endpoint is disabled. Face images,
landmarks and animation values are processed locally and are not uploaded by
the full-face rig.

The complete Apache 2.0 license is included in MediaPipe-LICENSE.txt.
